question.text: Are hepatitis G virus and TT virus involved in cryptogenic chronic liver disease?

medgemma_4b.clinical_reasoning: Hepatitis G virus (HGV) and Hepatitis delta virus (HDV) are known causes of chronic liver disease, particularly in the setting of chronic hepatitis C infection. While the exact prevalence of HGV and HDV in cryptogenic chronic liver disease is not precisely defined, they are considered potential contributors, especially in cases where other common causes are ruled out. Therefore, it is reasonable to consider them as potential factors.
